title: Retry a daily export
context: A fictional command-line export of public sample records. No provider or production data is required.
constraints: Use synthetic fixtures and the real application entry points.

goals.outcome: A retry produces one complete export without duplicating rows.

visuals.commitment: A retry produces one complete export without duplicating rows.
A missing required ID fails the export with a useful error and preserves the previous complete export byte for byte.

checks.label: Export every record
checks.expectation: The daily export contains all 120 synthetic records exactly once, with stable record IDs.
checks.conditions: The source fixture contains 120 unique IDs and remains unchanged during the run.
checks.method: Run the export command against the synthetic source and inspect the output. Compare the complete ID set and row count with the fixture.

checks.label: Retry after interruption
checks.expectation: A retry after interruption produces the same 120 unique records as an uninterrupted export.
checks.conditions: Interrupt after row 60 using a controlled fault; keep the same source fixture.
checks.method: Run until the injected interruption, retry using the documented command, and compare the complete output to an uninterrupted run. Assert 120 unique IDs and no partial replacement.

checks.label: Reject an invalid record
checks.expectation: A missing required ID fails the export with a useful error and preserves the previous complete export byte for byte.
checks.conditions: Start with a complete previous export; insert one source record without an ID.
checks.method: Run the export command and check its nonzero exit, error identifying the missing ID, and an exact byte comparison of the prior output.
